title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
lede: Isomorphic Labs, the Google DeepMind spinout building an AI drug-design engine, raised a $5 billion Series C to move its drug candidates into clinical trials.

points: Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital co-led, Andreessen Horowitz joined as a new investor, and every existing backer, including GV and the U.K. Sovereign AI Fund, returned.
Its engine combines simulation models across areas of chemistry and builds on DeepMind's AlphaFold protein-structure work.
The company reports positive preclinical results in oncology and immunology and has deals with Eli Lilly, Novartis and Johnson & Johnson.
The round follows a $2.1 billion Series B in May; Isomorphic did not disclose a valuation.
It is the first raise since Demis Hassabis left the head of DeepMind role to focus on drug discovery.
